shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "Downshift useCombobox getItemProps onMouseDown preventDownshiftDefault focus blur click selection" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/downshift-combobox-item-mousedown.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Preserve combobox input focus during item selection

For Downshift-style comboboxes, item "'`mousedown` must compose the consumer handler before Downshift'"'s default-prevention handler. Calling "'`preventDefault()` on the native mousedown keeps the input focused through click selection, while checking `preventDownshiftDefault` through the shared event composer preserves consumer control.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
